candidate_gate_rule: From the same unfiltered top-five result at diagnostic dense threshold >0.0, retain only exact selected passages whose own dense cosine is strictly greater than the swept cutoff. If none remain, classify no adequate local evidence. This is an offline post-retrieval gate simulation, not the current fallback implementation.
selection_policy: Do not select or approve a new threshold from this reused, assistant-authored 11-positive/2-negative set. Report the full grid and score overlap; require independent adjudication, broader no-evidence cases, and AI Architect sign-off before any runtime change.
